steps.note: start: a Ghostty window on m4max at a shell prompt
1. attach a Herdr client to Paul's Dev1 session smarty-dev
1. attach: Return; the client draws Paul's session
2. search for the candidate Pi workspace (zq147cand)
2. open the candidate Pi pane (Pi with pi-fabric#147 build 50de923)

steps.text: Use fabric_exec once: call agents.spawn({name:"reload-victim", transport:"process", model:"cliproxyapi-anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", task:"Run the shell command: sleep 240; then reply DONE."}) without residency, and do not wait. Reply with its id and status.
steps.note: 3. ask Pi to spawn a non-durable task agent
4. type /reload while the task agent runs
4. reload; after the redraw the notice names reload-victim and suggests residency: durable
5. reload again, with no task agent running
5. after this redraw no new 'The last /reload stopped' notice appears
6. detach: q; the local shell prompt returns
